name: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Ltd
about: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration (KHERL), manufactures fin and tube-type heat exchangers for the Heat Ventilation Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Industry.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] KRN Heat Exchangers designs, manufactures, and supplies heat exchangers and related thermal solutions. These products are used for efficient heat transfer between fluids, typically for heating and cooling applications.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 9.72 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 107 days to 153 days
